jobs.title: AI Alignment On-Ramp for Southeast Asia (free 8-week pilot)
jobs.summary: A free 8-week pilot for anyone in Southeast Asia who wants to think seriously about AI alignment. No research background required — just curiosity. Weekly sessions on weekday evenings (SGT), led by local TAs, with a curriculum inspired by Iliad's program. Runs September to November 2026 (exact dates TBC).
requirements: Curiosity about AI safety - no research background needed
jobs.notes: Express interest via the site. Deadline shown is an estimate - the program launches in September 2026 with exact dates TBC, so interest is best expressed early.

jobs.title: Campus Director (student leadership, part-time)
jobs.location: On campus (any university; remote support from ET team)
jobs.summary: Help fellow students make their theses better for them and for the world. Campus Directors run Effective Thesis's 8-week Accelerator (structured like an EA intro fellowship): light supported recruiting, then guiding a cohort through frameworks like ITN and Theory of Change to connect academic work to pressing global challenges. ET alumni have gone on to MIT, the Institute for Progress, the Tony Blair Institute, and Anthropic.
responsibilities: Run one cohort session per week plus light prep (about 4-6 hours/week over 8 weeks, mid-October to early December)
Light, supported on-campus recruiting for your cohort
Facilitate frameworks (ITN, Theory of Change) with training and materials provided by the ET team
requirements: No prior facilitation experience needed - training provided
jobs.notes: Applications are rolling - apply ASAP; interest is high. Includes a small stipend (US$125), 1:1 mentorship, public credit on the ET website, and a reference. Deadline shown here is an estimate tied to the mid-October program start; the true process is rolling.
